correctness.rationale: The exact eight-row reduced action is reconstructed from the primary full text. Dephasing rows and an even row permutation leave two four-by-four rational blocks with determinant 1; the row-phase product is ω^(4d)=1. Direct reciprocal-pair multiplication gives trace(M²)=(4d−8−2d[2cos(2π/d)])/d². At d=3 it equals 10/9; at d=5 its field norm is 164/625. For every odd d≥7 every conjugate is strictly smaller than 1 in absolute value, and the value is nonzero, so it cannot be an algebraic integer. A global scalar-power revival with determinant 1 would imply finite ordinary order and thus an algebraic-integer squared trace, contradiction. Spectral simplicity implies the generic-state corollary. 603 independent finite matrix assertions supplement but do not replace this proof.

value.rationale: The source identifies parity-dependent stationary/reduced harmonic sectors but does not settle exact global phase-synchronized returns. The new theorem completely classifies all-dimension collective projective revival (rather than sampled periods) for two physically natural sign configurations, and proves almost-every-vector nonrevival in odd dimensions. Exact quantum-walk revival is a structural transport/coherence property and all-dimension root-of-unity exclusion is a meaningful boundary, not a normalization check or isolated parameter slice.
